career.title: SEO Executive
career.description: We are looking for a passionate SEO Executive who enjoys improving website rankings and driving organic growth. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on SEO experience who wants to grow their career in digital marketing.
responsibilities: Perform keyword research and implement on-page SEO strategies.
Optimize website pages, blogs, and landing pages.
Monitor website performance and keyword rankings.
Conduct SEO audits and fix technical issues.
Work with content and development teams for SEO implementation.
Requirements: Good understanding of on-page, off-page, and technical SEO.
Experience with SEO tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, Ahrefs, or SEMrush.
Familiarity with WordPress and basic HTML/CSS.
career.short_description: Start your journey with i‑Cons Technologies. Apply today and build your future in digital innovation.
